messages.subject: RE: Helio negotiation — our position
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks for taking us through the issues note. We're agreed: go back at 125% on the general cap and offer the fixed £3,000,000 super-cap for data protection and confidentiality — we are not willing to accept uncapped exposure there. Keep the anonymised-data right. On termination for convenience, we'd prefer no early exit at all, but we can live with your 90-day / after-year-2 position if needed.

Nadia
